note: Milestone 70, 70G: what converting a filing into each type the app offers produces, recorded from the app before 70G moved conversion out of legacy-app.js by tests/e2e/filing-conversion.characterization.spec.ts. Regenerate only for a deliberate, recorded change. Changed by Milestone 71 (2026-09-29): 71B added fields to the Inventory, Annual-family and Simplified blanks (attorneyWaiverBasis, attorneyWaiverOrderDate, certGuardianSign*, certifiesService, serviceGuardian), which every converted filing now carries; 71E made every carry one function -- Annual family to Annual family carries Line 20 when the source has no Schedule D figure (the minimal fixture has none: 10500, where Line 30 was a meaningless 0), an Initial Inventory converted into an Annual or Final now carries its Summary I total (it carried nothing), nothing is carried into or out of a Trust Accounting (empty Starting Balance), and each carry records startingBalanceCarry. Changed by Milestone 72B (2026-10-02): every conversion and carry now carries the attorney's primary and secondary email under the destination's own keys; the Simplified Plan and the Annual Plan now receive the attorney's name, Bar number, phone, emails and address (the Annual Plan had only the name, the Simplified Plan nothing); the keys attorneyBar/attorneyPhone/attorneyEmail, which the Annual never reads, are no longer written; the Inventory's attorney carries email and secondaryEmail; and the browser suite's Inventory overlay now names its attorney's email, which arrives on every destination. Changed by Milestones 72C and 72H (2026-10-02; regenerated after the mid-build regression): the Initial Plan's guardian rows carry an email key (72C); a converted Simplified Plan source records certSignerMigrated (72C's once-only certificate signer pin, set when it is opened); a conversion into a Simplified Accounting writes no certificate attorney details -- the certificate's attorney is the filing's (72H) -- and an opened Inventory or Simplified source records certAttorneyMigrated. No other mapping changed. Changed by Milestone 72G (2026-10-02, the certificate's lifecycle): a same-period conversion (Annual family <-> Simplified) carries the recipients and the ward's status (certWardStatus) and starts the service date, the method, every certificate signature and the attorney's own Part V signature date blank; Inventory -> Simplified, a later filing, no longer carries the Inventory's service date; destinations gain certWardStatus, opened Annual and Simplified sources certIndicatorMigrated, and the Inventory serviceMethod. Checked against 72G step 6's table. Changed by Milestone 73A (83352d0, 2026-10-06; recorded in the full regression after 73F part 2): every new filing is created under the signature rule "guardians sign by hand or by stamp" (signaturePolicy 2), and a converted filing is a new filing, so all 24 conversions carry signaturePolicy: 2; nothing else moved. Opening an older filing applies the same rule. Regenerated by Milestone 73B (2026-10-07, no answer the filer didn't give): a filing converted into an Annual, Final or Trust Accounting no longer gets guardianRelationship 'Professional Guardian' (it starts blank); and the minimal Annual fixture now states a Type of Guardianship ('Plenary'), which a conversion from it carries. Nothing else changed. Regenerated by Milestone 74P (2026-10-07): new keys only -- the 'same as' boxes (officeSameAsMailing on every converted Annual-family and Annual Plan guardian; mailingSameAsResidence on a converted Annual or Initial Plan), each false; conversion carries a ticked box with its addresses. Nothing else changed. Regenerated by Milestone 73O part 2 (2026-10-08): every certificate recipient is a name and four address lines, so converted filings' recipients carry line4 and line5 (and the Simplified's line4), and an Inventory's recipients are line2-line5 in place of address and cityStateZip; recipients copy whole between forms. The fixtures' recipients are blank, so only keys moved; no value changed.
